correctness.rationale: Exact Fano incidence representation; independent enumeration and subset transform agree with 21-edge matching recursion on all 2,097,152 subsets. Two exhaustive acyclic Morse matchings per threshold verified by topological sorting all incidences; reverse-order critical counts yield the stated full CW models. The signed degree-8-to-7 Morse boundary has a unit coefficient; degree-10-to-9 boundary has a maximal determinant -1 minor, giving primitive attaching maps. Hurewicz and CW cell cancellation imply the integral sphere wedges. Reproducible C++17 code and exact output are included. A second element-order matching independently produces a unit threshold-five boundary and a distinct unimodular 6-by-6 threshold-six boundary minor.
